Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays due to an earlier faulty train at Chancery Lane.

Circle.reason: Circle Line: Minor delays due to train cancellations.

District.reason: District Line: Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 September, no service between Edgware Road and Wimbledon. Rail Replacement bus services will operate. If travelling to/from Fulham vs Crystal Palace on Saturday, it may be easier to walk to/from Hammersmith.

Elizabeth line.reason: No service between Paddington and Heathrow Terminals / Reading  due to a fire alert in the Paddington area. SEVERE DELAYS on the rest of the line. Avoid using the Elizabeth line. For trains to Heathrow Airport use the Piccadilly line. Tickets are being accepted by London Underground, London Buses, Thameslink, DLR, South Western Railway and Southeastern.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: Minor delays between Amersham and Moor Park southbound only due to an earlier faulty train at Amersham. The next southbound departure from Amersham will be the 23:22. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Severe delays between Acton Town and Heathrow Terminals due to an earlier trespasser at Hammersmith. London Underground tickets will be accepted on London buses, Weaver line, Great Northern and South Western Railway. MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Windrush.reason: WINDRUSH LINE: Saturday 5, all day, and Sunday 6 September, until 1915, no service between Surrey Quays and Clapham Junction / Battersea Park. There will also be no SOUTHERN trains at Queens Road Peckham and Peckham Rye. Replacement bus service M operates between Canada Water and Clapham Junction via Surrey Quays, Queens Road Peckham, Peckham Rye, Denmark Hill, Clapham High Street and Wandsworth Road. In addition, replacement buses operate between London Bridge and Tulse Hill via South Bermondsey, Queens Road Peckham, Peckham Rye, East Dulwich, North Dulwich and Herne Hill.
